Title: Login form accepts whitespace-only credentials
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Go to /login
2. Enter spaces only in username field
3. Enter spaces only in password field
4. Click Login
Expected Result: Form should reject empty/whitespace input with validation error
Actual Result: Form submits and shows a generic server error instead of client-side validation

Title: Email field accepts invalid format 'user@' without error
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to contact form
2. Enter 'user@' in the email field
3. Fill other required fields
4. Submit form
Actual Result: Form submits successfully with invalid email — no error shown

Title: Todo counter not updated after deleting completed item
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create 3 todos
2. Mark 2 as complete
3. Delete 1 completed todo
Expected Result: Counter should decrement to reflect remaining active items
Actual Result: Counter remains unchanged at original count

Title: API POST /posts returns 500 for empty body payload
Expected Result: Server should return 400 Bad Request with error message
Actual Result: Server returns 500 Internal Server Error — unhandled exception

Title: Mobile viewport cuts off login button on iPhone 13
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open login page on mobile (375px width)
2. Scroll down to form
3. Observe Submit button
Expected Result: Submit button fully visible and tappable
Actual Result: Submit button is partially hidden behind the mobile keyboard and cannot be tapped without dismissing keyboard

Title: XSS payload reflected in error message without encoding
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Enter in username 2. Enter any password 3. Submit form
Expected Result: Input sanitised — error message shows plain text only
Actual Result: Script executes — alert box fires in browser indicating stored XSS vulnerability

Title: Form reset button only clears text fields — dropdowns remain selected
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Fill entire form including dropdown
2. Click Reset button
Expected Result: All fields including dropdowns reset to default/empty
Actual Result: Text inputs cleared but <select> dropdown retains previously selected value

Title: Logout does not invalidate server-side session
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login with valid credentials
2. Copy session token from cookies
3. Click Logout
4. Re-use copied token in direct API request
Actual Result: API responds with 200 and returns user data — session token still valid after logout

Title: Page load time exceeds 3 seconds on slow 3G throttling
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open DevTools > Network
2. Throttle to Slow 3G
3. Reload the page
4. Measure load time
Expected Result: Page loads within 3 seconds on Slow 3G
Actual Result: Page takes 6.8 seconds to reach interactive state — no loading skeleton or indicator

Title: Console error thrown on navigation to /profile when not logged in
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Clear all cookies/session
2. Navigate directly to /profile
3. Open browser console
Expected Result: Redirect to /login with no console errors
Actual Result: Uncaught TypeError thrown before redirect fires: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading userId)'

Title: Double-click submit creates duplicate form entries
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Fill out form completely
2. Click Submit
3. Immediately double-click Submit button
Actual Result: Two identical entries appear in the database — no debounce or submit-once protection

Title: API GET /users returns user passwords in plaintext
Expected Result: Password field should not be present in response
Actual Result: password field with plaintext value returned for every user object

Title: Form phone field accepts alphabetic characters
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Navigate to contact form
2. Type 'abcdefg' in phone field
3. Observe validation
Expected Result: Phone field should only accept digits, +, -, (, )
Actual Result: Alphabetic input accepted without any validation message — data saved as-is

Title: Password field value visible in page source after login failure
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Enter credentials on login page
2. Submit with wrong password
3. View page source
Expected Result: Password value NOT present in HTML source
Actual Result: Password input value attribute serialised in page source: <input value='wrongpass'>

Title: Broken avatar image on dashboard for users with special chars in name
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Login as user with name containing '&' or '%'
2. Navigate to dashboard
Actual Result: Avatar src URL contains unencoded characters — 404 returned for image
